correctness.rationale: Projector spectral decomposition holds for every partition and dimension. Exact cross-part entry provides necessity, strictly positive within-part quadratic (discriminant negative) plus strictly positive diagonal via Taylor remainder provides sufficiency, and an increasing cubic gives unique sharp cutoff. An exact-rational verifier independently replayed 96054 finite assertions. All quantifiers and boundary cases including singleton parts are handled analytically.

value.rationale: A natural all-dimensional full graph family has an exact sharp positive numerical timestep despite RK4 universal positivity radius zero. The cutoff coincides precisely with spectral stability independent of graph partition, with a sharp cancellation of all interpart probabilities. This supplies a structurally motivated, useful benchmark for heat diffusion on complete multipartite and irregular hub networks; it is not implied by the available graph eigenvalue formula or a small finite experiment.
